text:
Alex: ran nsys on the failing perf cluster (g5x2) — seeing repeated H2D stalls aligned with small KV prefetches, looks like pageable memcpy backpressure
perf-bot: nsys report uploaded: https://artifacts.local/nsys/trace-1727809012.qdrep (summary attached) :eyes:
Alex: summary TL;DR from the trace:
```
Total H2D memcpy time: 38% of active time
Top kernels: kv_prefetch_async (avg 1.1ms, 18k calls), cudaMemcpyHtoDAsync (avg 0.9ms, 22k calls), dma_peercopy (avg 0.6ms, 5k calls)
Notable: long tail in cudaMemcpy* where host pages were pageable => serialization in driver, spikes at load peaks
```
Maria: can you paste the nvlink/pcie timeline snapshot? curious if peercopy is contending with H2D or if it's purely host->device
Alex: clipped timeline (nsys timeline view):
```
[0ms] kernel: kv_prefetch_async (0.8ms)
[1.2ms] cudaMemcpyHtoDAsync (host pageable) -> stalls until host page pinned (~2.5ms)
[4.0ms] dma_peercopy (nvlink) overlaps with memcpy but waits on bus -> queueing increases
High conc: 30-40% of windows show queue depth > 8 for H2D -> increasing latency for small batches
```
Dmitri: hmm that suggests two problems: 1) pageable allocations causing driver pin-on-demand overhead, 2) our batching heuristic is creating many tiny H2D ops that could coalesce
Jess: did you try preallocating pinned host buffers or using cudaHostAlloc? any numbers?
Alex: ran a quick A/B on the same workload:
- baseline (pageable, current batching): median token latency 18.2ms, H2D stall tax ~+4.5ms per request
- pinned prealloc + reuse: median token latency 12.6ms, H2D stall tax ~+1.2ms per request (roughly 60% reduction)
Note: total throughput improved ~22% under sustained load because queue churn reduced
Maria: nice. How invasive is the change to prealloc pinning in the serving runtime? can we do a fast opt-in toggle?
Alex: minimal: allocate a pool of host pinned pages per GPU at startup, hand out from pool for KV prefetch and input copies, fallback to pageable only if pool exhausted. patch prototype attached in gist: `https://gist.local/prealloc-pool`
Dmitri: aside from pinning, we should also tweak kernel selection and batching heuristics: when sequence length < 64 and kv_prefetch rate high, prefer a coalescing mode that batches multiple small prefetches into a single larger pinned H2D. That should reduce number of cudaMemcpy calls and NVLink arbitration.
Jess: sounds good — can we add a quick feature flag and metrics so we can canary it? need tokens/sec, h2d_stall_ms, and queue_depth histograms
Alex: proposed flags: `--pin-host-pool-size=64`, `--batch-coalesce-threshold=48`, `--coalesce-window-ms=2`
Alex: quick patch diff (pseudo):
```
if (req.seq_len < coalesce_threshold) {
  aggregate_into_shard_buffer(req.input_vertices);
  submit_one_h2d(pinned_shard_buf);
} else {
  submit_h2d_per_request();
}
```
Maria: any change to kernel selection? kernel pick currently picks `kv_prefetch_async` variant A for long sequences and variant B for short (faster but forces more H2D).
Dmitri: change pick rule: if H2D queue_depth > 6 OR h2d_stall_ms > 1.5 then prefer variant A (which does more on-GPU prefetch and fewer host copies). Add a fallback to dma_peercopy when nvlink peer available and target already warmed.
Jess: I'll run the canary on int-cluster tomorrow morning with `--pin-host-pool-size=64` and the new coalesce flag. Will post results. cc @Alex @Dmitri
perf-bot: canary task created: rc-2197, notify #eng-runtime-canary on completion
Alex: followups: 1) add NVTX ranges around prefetch/copy so traces show coalescing boundaries, 2) instrument host allocation path to emit `page_status` (pinned|pageable) for each H2D call, 3) add unit to documentation that pinned pool must be sized to expected concurrency to avoid fallback
Maria: assign and timeline? we need canary metrics by EOD tomorrow to decide rollout for next agent deploy
Dmitri: i'll take the kernel-selection guard and NVTX ranges (PR by midday), Alex will finish pool impl and tests, Jess runs canary and collects dashboards
Jess: noted, will ping here with the first run summary (nsys + histograms). thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Alex: one more note — prealloc increases host memory footprint but for 16GB GPUs a pool of 64x8MB pages = 512MB is fine. observed no OOMs on int cluster during test.
Maria: perfect. If canary looks good we can flip default in next minor release and add migration notes.
Dmitri: also capturing a small doc blurb: reason for coalescing is to reduce number of distinct H2D ops (less driver pinning + fewer NVLink arbitration points) which reduces tail latency. will add to infra/perf-runbook.
Jess: will post run at 1727810400 with artifacts.
